transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you in today?

Well, I guess I'm here because lately I just can't keep my head clear at work. It's really frustrating. Like, I'll be sitting there in a session, and I completely lose track of what my clients are saying. And you know, as a therapist, that's pretty much the whole job. It reminds me of this one time I was trying to learn how to play the guitar, and I just couldn't get my fingers to do what my brain was telling them to do. I bought this really nice acoustic one, too, a Yamaha, thinking it would motivate me, but it just sat in the corner of my room gathering dust for months. Anyway, yeah, I'll be rereading the same chart note over and over again, and nothing sticks. Then I just freeze on these simple decisions I used to handle without even thinking about it. It's like my brain is just stuck in mud.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I guess... I definitely don't care about much right now. Like I said, my guitar has just been sitting in the corner. And I keep bailing on my soccer league. I also stopped going to the animal shelter to volunteer, which makes me feel kind of bad because there's this one dog there, a terrier mix named Barnaby, and he always used to wait for me to walk him. He had this funny little limp from before he got rescued, and I was trying to teach him how to sit using these specific liver treats. You have to get them from this one local pet store across town, though, and the traffic on the highway is just a nightmare lately. They've been doing construction on the overpass for like six months and it completely backs up everything past the downtown exit, so you just sit there burning gas... 

Um, but yeah, what was I saying? Oh, right. Even when I try to force myself to do stuff I usually like, like cooking or going hiking, it just feels like I'm going through the motions. There's just no point to it anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these symptoms been present most days and for how long?

Well, I guess it's been about a month now. Most days, yeah, almost every day. It really started right around the time the clinic lost a bunch of staff. They totally shifted my schedule around, so now I'm doing all this late-evening coverage. And the paperwork... it's all these heavy crisis notes now. 

It reminds me of when I used to work the closing shift at this diner back in high school. We had this manager, Dave, who would always leave early and stick me with the deep fryer cleaning. That grease trap was just the worst, honestly. You'd have to scrape it out with this special metal spatula, and the smell would just cling to your uniform no matter how many times you washed it. I tried using that heavy-duty detergent with the orange scent, but it didn't even touch it. My mom actually made me start leaving my work shoes out in the garage because she couldn't stand the smell in the hallway. Our garage was so cluttered anyway, mostly with my dad's old fishing gear. He used to take me out to the lake when I was a kid... 

But, uh, anyway, yeah. About a month of feeling like this, pretty much every day since the schedule change.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months in the past where you felt completely back to normal, where you weren't experiencing these kinds of symptoms?

Two months back to normal? Um... I'm not really sure what you mean. Like, I don't think I've ever felt this way before, so there hasn't really been a "back to normal" yet. I've always just kind of been my regular self until recently. 

Like last summer, I was totally fine. I actually went on this massive road trip with my buddy Mark. We drove his old Honda Civic all the way out west. The AC was completely busted, though, so we had to drive through the desert with the windows down. The wind was so loud we couldn't even hear the radio, which was super annoying because I spent hours making this perfect playlist. Mark ended up spilling a giant blue raspberry slushie all over the passenger seat on the second day, and it stained the fabric bright blue. We tried scrubbing it out with club soda at this weird desert gas station that sold all these bizarre alien souvenirs... they had these little green alien bobbleheads that I almost bought for my desk at work. 

But, um... sorry, my brain is just wandering again. What did you ask? Oh, right. Yeah, no, I haven't had these symptoms in the past, so I haven't had a two-month break from them or anything. This is all pretty much the first time it's been like this.
